Indications for Use (Describe)
™
The Codman Libertis EVD Catheter with Bactiseal® and Endexo® Technology is indicated for
gaining access to the ventricles of the brain and can be used with dimensionally compatible devices
for draining cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and other fluids of similar physical characteristics as a means
of reducing intracranial pressure and CSF volume.
